builders.label: The Builders
builders.blurb: Shipping code, breaking things, fixing them again. Open to anyone who is actually writing something.

data-circle.label: Data Circle
data-circle.blurb: Spreadsheets, notebooks and the eternal argument about which chart to use. Beginners very welcome.

product-clinic.label: Product Clinic
product-clinic.blurb: Roadmaps, prioritisation and saying no to things you would rather build.

design-table.label: Design Table
design-table.blurb: Pixels, type and the space between. Critiques are kind and specific here.

front-end.label: Front-End Bench
front-end.blurb: Interfaces, accessibility and everything that runs in the browser. Ship it, then make it fast.

PEOPLE.name: Himanshu Bisht
PEOPLE.blurb: Six months into a data career and posting the spreadsheet mistakes that cost me a week, so you do not pay for them too.

PEOPLE.name: Dev Sharma
PEOPLE.blurb: Building small tools end to end. Currently one very opinionated habit tracker with a login page that took three weeks.

PEOPLE.name: Aman Chauhan
PEOPLE.blurb: I care about what a page feels like on the cheapest phone someone actually owns. Motion budget goes to the interaction, not the entrance.

PEOPLE.name: Harshit Chaurasiya
PEOPLE.blurb: Shipped a career path tool that reads like a conversation. First version is up and I would genuinely like it torn apart.

PEOPLE.name: Priya Nair
PEOPLE.blurb: ML engineer. The boring 80 percent is data plumbing and evaluation, and I write about that part more than the notebooks.

PEOPLE.name: Rohit Verma
PEOPLE.blurb: Deployments, pipelines and the on-call week nobody warns you about. If it only works on my laptop, I want to hear about it.

PEOPLE.name: Sneha Iyer
PEOPLE.blurb: Designing for people who are already tired. My case studies are mostly about what I removed, which is apparently the whole job.

PEOPLE.name: Arjun Mehta
PEOPLE.blurb: Security analyst. I explain the log line that told you what was wrong three days before it mattered.

PEOPLE.name: Kavya Reddy
PEOPLE.blurb: Android and iOS. Shipping one app at a time and writing down what each store review taught me.

PEOPLE.name: Devansh Gupta
PEOPLE.blurb: Growth and content. Half my job is finding out which idea nobody wanted, quickly, before a quarter is spent on it.

PEOPLE.name: Fatima Khan
PEOPLE.blurb: Backend and the databases underneath it. I like boring technology that is still working five years later.

PEOPLE.name: Vivek Joshi
PEOPLE.blurb: From a non-technical degree into analytics at 27. Writing the honest version of the transition, including the year it was slow.
